Skill in living and fighting as a bat.
Overview
The Giant Bat is a
Beast Form
with the unique ability to fly while effectively fighting enemies, limited only by the flight's power usage.
Bats have a variety of abilities, which range from knock-back, recovery, damage, and a concussion, making it potentially compatible with any skill-set a bat can use.
You can cure Giant Bat form by buying an Un-Bat Juice from
Harry the Wolf
for 4500 councils. You can cure Fevered Trismus by using Treat Disease 1, a level 15
First Aid
ability, which requires a basic first aid kit or better to use.
Training
Levels 51-60 along with 61-70 can be unlocked by talking to
Yavazek
.
Noita the Green
unlocks 71-80.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Big Footed Jim
deep beneath
Povus
.
In-Game Description
Skill in living and fighting as a bat.
How to Obtain
Another bat player (who must be at least level 8) can repeatedly use Virulent Bite on you for a chance to give the Fevered Trismus disease which will change you into a bat after two hours of logged-in real time. During the Halloween event, one may also be bitten by an enemy bat's rage attack for Fevered Trismus. Finally, enemy bats on the lower levels of the
Labyrinth
or
Gazluk Keep
dungeons can inflict Fevered Trismus on players.
2023 Special Event
Until July 20, 2023, the
Happy-Go-Lucky Bat
(normally available only during Halloween) is temporarily located right outside of the north gate of
Serbule
, by the bridge. He will transform players into a Giant Bat (and back) for free, along with offering training for Giant Bat skills.
This can be used by any character, including newly made ones that just freshly arrived from
Anagoge Island

such as the

and

, even fewer NPCs will talk to you than to most animals. Additionally, some animals that normally talk to others animals will not talk to the Giant Bat (for example,
Red
). Before changing into a bat, it is recommended that you be an experienced player. (Unless you're up for a challenge!)
Note
: If you were a
Druid
before becoming a Giant Bat and sufficiently high level (25 or higher) to transform into a deer (or bird), you can use that to interact with the NPCs who will talk to animals, but not bats.
Flight
Immediately after transforming, a bat is able to fly. Flight is faster than sprinting which makes travel easier, however flying drains power.
Default flight controls: R, Page Up, and Number Pad 9 to fly; F, Page Down, and Number Pad 3 to land.
Echolocation
Bats get Echolocation, which sometimes makes seeing at night much easier. They also get Combat Echolocation which comes with a 7% evasion bonus at the cost of 1 movement speed.
